text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for tenant=citrine, cluster=dedi-us-west-2-07 — latency above SLO (p95 ~ 2.9s, baseline 400ms). Alert id PD#84921. Auto-page to oncall.

pagerduty: Notification: PagerDuty incident PD#84921 created by incident-bot.

mira: acked. I'm on it — looking at dashboards now.

samira_sre: thx mira. i'm pulling logs for the cluster. any customer-reported errors?

mira: citrine support channel says API errors up ~0.3% but mostly timeouts. spikes started ~1768012000. forwarding stack traces.

alex_dev: seeing increased KV cache misses on the dedicated pool, eviction pressure high. node mem usage ~92% on gpu-3.

mira: agree. KV miss ratio jumped from 7% -> 48% for heavy-recent requests. p50 token latency up too.

jordan_pm: Citrine (customer) called support 5m ago. They're seeing intermittent 504s. Impacting checkout flow.

samira_sre: running quick health checks:
```
kubectl -n dedi-us-west-2-07 get pods -o wide | grep model-server
# pod model-server-7 has 5 restarts in last 10m
```

elaine_ops: I can spin a temporary hotpool and route some traffic if we want to offload. autoscaler isn't kicking due to reserved capacity floor.

mira: try hotpool. also enable KV-cache-prefetch flag for model variant xlarge-quant to reduce warmup misses.

alex_dev: pushing command to enable prefetch on cluster: `infractl cluster config apply --cluster dedi-us-west-2-07 --set runtime.kv_prefetch=true`

incident-bot: Config change detected by infractl (mira). Change id CHG-9932.

samira_sre: hotpool requested by elaine, provisioning nodes now. ETA ~2m. I'll watch the queue depth.

mira: rolling restart requested for the hottest pod to clear stray memory fragmentation: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-server --namespace=dedi-us-west-2-07 --selector=zone=us-west-2a`

jordan_pm: keeping citrine on the line (they're in standby). being transparent: "We're provisioning additional capacity and applying runtime cache optimizations; investigating root cause."

pagerduty: Incident PD#84921 updated: Acknowledged by mira.

alex_dev: note: model variant fallback policy triggered for ~18% of requests earlier — traffic was falling back to cpu-emulated variant which increased latency. I've tightened routing to prefer quant variants if available.

samira_sre: hotpool up. observed immediate drop in queue depth on dispatcher from 78 -> 12. p95 latency falling (now ~820ms).

mira: good. keep an eye for regressions. I'll leave cache prefetch enabled for 30m and then roll back if stable.

elaine_ops: notified infra finance: temporary hotpool will incur burst billing. Citrine customer is high-priority; ok to continue.

jordan_pm: Citrine confirmed reduced errors on their end, they see checkout success rate improving. thx.

mira: summarizing actions: 1) enabled runtime.kv_prefetch, 2) provisioned hotpool, 3) restarted hottest pod, 4) tightened routing to quant model variants.

samira_sre: creating incident timeline + assigning follow-up: root cause hypothesis = cache churn due to sudden workload shift + autoscaler floor preventing quick scale. Follow-ups: tune autoscaler floor for dedicated pools + add early-warning KV-miss alert.

jordan_pm: i'll file a customer incident update. tentative RCA cadence for next-week postmortem meeting.

mira: handing off to night oncall in 20m. leaving runbook notes in PD incident. If any re-escalation, page me on mobile.

pagerduty: PD#84921 status: acknowledged -> monitoring.

incident-bot: Auto-note: On-call handoff scheduled: mira -> samira_sre at 1768012800.

samira_sre: taking handoff early. I'm on watch for 30m to ensure stable.

elaine_ops: closing loop with citrine support: they asked for post-incident report. jordan please include timeline and mitigation details.

mira: will do. thanks team. :thumbsup:
